sources.notes: This project's transcription of Appendix F: Table F-1 (the effects a mitigation can have on a threat event), Tables F-3 to F-16 (for each ATT&CK tactic, its techniques with the mitigations, cyber resiliency approaches, potential effects and SP 800-53 controls printed for each) and Tables F-17 to F-19 (the candidate mitigations) from the PDF that transcribed_from names, made by scripts/reference-transcribe/sp800-160v2r1-appendix-f.mjs with pdftotext 26.04.0. The appendix analyses ATT&CK for Enterprise, which the publication cites as [MITRE18] (The MITRE Corporation, 2018, https://attack.mitre.org), and names no ATT&CK version. One control label it prints, CM-4(4) in Table F-8, names no control of the pinned SP 800-53 Rev. 5 catalog: it makes no link and is kept on its row as props.controls_not_in_catalog. The PDF is the authority and is not stored in the repository. The file's corrections list every place the transcription departs from the printed text.
